scope: WS1 feedback generalisation, independent validation, strong baselines. O'Neil = exposed development data; every ALMANAC number here is EXPLORATORY (opened 2026-10-03T17:58:48).

step1_receipts.result: all 11 arms' exploit/certify totals match summary.json on dev v2 and the confirmatory replay; 5 lines rerun with frozen replay.run_line give 0 mismatches

step2_decomposition.identities_verified: offset-only == static and drug-only == full under mean ranking (identical purchases in 39/39 and 60/60 lines)

draft_decisive_experiment.estimand: per target cell line, validated synergistic pairs found within a 10% budget in 4 rounds: feedback model vs the strongest static model with identical information and wells
draft_decisive_experiment.data: Jaaks et al. 2022 original anchored screen (figshare 16843597): colon 45 lines and pancreas 29 lines x 325 pairs, every pair screened in both anchor/library orientations on separate plates; breast restricted to its 300 two-orientation pairs as a secondary stratum
draft_decisive_experiment.split: per pair, a seeded coin (seed frozen before opening) assigns one orientation as the purchasable screen measurement and the other as the validation measurement; history = other lines of the same tissue, screen orientation only
draft_decisive_experiment.label: screen label = max over the two anchor concentrations of SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX (viability units x 100); hit = the authors' Synergy flag; validated hit = purchased pair with Synergy in the screen orientation AND in the validation orientation
draft_decisive_experiment.primary_endpoint: validated hits per line, feedback minus max(history, ridge static, GBM static) totals; 95% percentile bootstrap over lines (10,000, seed 20261003)
draft_decisive_experiment.meaningful_gain: lower bound > 0 AND point gain >= 10% of the strongest static arm's validated hits
draft_decisive_experiment.secondary: screen-orientation hits; validation rate; continuous delta-Emax of purchases; authors' validation rescreen (figshare 16843600: 50/30/40 pre-selected pairs x 33/35/29 lines) on its restricted menu as a selective diagnostic
draft_decisive_experiment.stop_rules: continue if meaningful gain holds; modify (replicate-aware or shrunk drug-in-line feedback, verification allocation) if screen gain holds but validated gain CI includes 0; stop the feedback claim if the validated-gain upper bound < 5% of the static arm
draft_decisive_experiment.prerequisites: freeze builder + protocol + seeds + verdict code before any outcome column is read; decide single-agent context source (same-plate singles are coupled to labels; GDSC2 single-agent release is a separate screen); log the one opening
